items.name: krisgfx9/Wireless-Device-Battery-Monitor
items.description: Show the battery level of wireless mice, headsets, keyboards and controllers on the Windows 10/11 taskbar. Lightweight tray app, no vendor software needed. Supports Logitech, Razer, SteelSeries, Corsair, HyperX, Glorious, PS4/PS5 DualSense, Xbox and Bluetooth devices.
items.purpose: Hiển thị mức pin thiết bị không dây trên thanh tác vụ Windows

items.name: Noniv/abyssal-garden
items.description: A dreamy underwater world you can swim through in your browser: swaying kelp forests, sunbeams, a sunken ship and manta rays. Everything is generated by code with WebGPU (no images, models or sound files), all in a single 97 KB HTML file.
items.purpose: Trải nghiệm thế giới dưới nước trong trình duyệt, sinh ra bằng WebGPU

items.description: Rewrite your whole app in Rust, one piece at a time, checked against the original's recorded behavior at every step. CLIs, HTTP servers and libraries in TypeScript, Python, C, Go, Ruby and Java.
